quote: Section 2.2 provides that the Agreement "shall automatically renew for successive five-year Renewal Terms" unless a Party gives written notice of non-renewal "not more than 270 days and not less than 240 days before the expiration of the Initial Term." That is a 30-day window falling approximately between mid-June and mid-July 2026. ... The narrow 30-day window creates a recurring trap: missing it by a single day locks the Company in for another five years.
